concepts.name: Kinetic Energy
concepts.simple_definition: Kinetic energy is the energy possessed by an object due to its motion.
concepts.deep_explanation: The formula is KE = 1/2 m v². It depends on the mass and the square of its speed. It is a scalar measured in Joules (J).
concepts.real_example: A running athlete has kinetic energy; when they stop, the kinetic energy becomes zero.
concepts.common_confusion: Forgetting to square the velocity when computing kinetic energy.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ኪነቲክ ኢነርጂ ማለት አንድ ቁስ በመንቀሳቀሱ ምክንያት የሚኖረው የစွမ်းይ አይነት ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: ቀመሩ KE = 1/2 m v² ነው። በክብደት እና በፍጥነቱ ስኩዌር ላይ የተመሠረተ ነው። አሃዱ ጁል (J) ነው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: የሚሮጥ ስፖርተኛ ኪነቲክ ኢነርጂ አለው፤ ሲቆም ግን ኪነቲክ ኢነርጂው ዜሮ ይሆናል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: ኪነቲክ ኢነርጂን ሲያሰሉ የፍጥነቱን ስኩዌር ማድረግ መርሳት።

concepts.name: 92 Unit 4 Static And Current Electricity
concepts.simple_definition: 92 Unit 4 Static and Current Electricity 4.1 Charges in Nature By the end of this section, you should be able to: • distinguish between the two types of electric charges; • show that the total electric charge in an isolated system is conserved; • use conservation of charge to calculate quantities of charge trans- ferred between objects
